name: China economy
summary: China's October factory output rose 4.8% and retail sales 0.4%, both below forecasts; Q3 growth 4.5%, within target
state: Data released on 16 Nov showed October industrial output up 4.8% a year and retail sales up 0.4%, both below forecasts, while fixed-asset investment fell 8.1% in January–October and property investment 21.6% (Reuters, CNBC). Growth was 4.5% in the third quarter, at the bottom of the 4.5–5.0% target, and the statistics bureau said it expects the target to be met (Reuters). Prices rose in October, ruling out deflation, and no new developer default wave or financial contagion was found, so Normal holds with momentum weakening.
for_you: Exporters, commodity producers and firms selling to Chinese consumers are exposed to weaker domestic demand in China. Slower Chinese growth can weigh on global trade and prices for raw materials.
rubric_hit: Q3 growth 4.5% near 4.5–5.0% target, no deflation or contagion: Normal; weak October data short of Watch

sources.title: Reuters via Yahoo News — China's economy falters as factory output, retail sales undershoot expectations
CNBC — China's slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates

why: China is the world's factory and the biggest marginal buyer of commodities; a hard landing would ripple through every supply chain.
drivers: Property sector, local-government debt, exports and tariffs, deflation, stimulus.

rubric.alert: Hard landing (growth < 3%), financial contagion, or capital controls tightened sharply.
rubric.watch: Deflation, renewed property-developer defaults, or growth clearly below target.
rubric.normal: Growth near official target, stable property sales, no financial contagion.
